findings.codeql_raw_query:
/**
 * @name Code injection via eval/exec in lxml
 * @description Using eval or exec with untrusted input can lead to arbitrary code execution
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity error
 * @id py/code-injection-lxml
 * @tags security
 *        external/cwe/cwe-094
 */

import python
import semmle.python.ApiGraphs

from DataFlow::CallCfgNode call
where
  call = API::builtin("eval").getACall() or
  call = API::builtin("exec").getACall() or
  call = API::builtin("compile").getACall()
select call, "Potentially dangerous code execution function call."
findings.hypothesis: Find eval/exec calls in lxml package that could lead to code injection

message.text: Potentially dangerous code execution function call.

findings.codeql_raw_query:
/**
 * @name Dangerous eval/exec usage in lxml
 * @description Using eval or exec with untrusted input can lead to arbitrary code execution
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity error
 * @id py/code-injection-lxml-eval
 * @tags security
 *        external/cwe/cwe-094
 */

import python
import semmle.python.ApiGraphs

from DataFlow::CallCfgNode call
where
  call = API::builtin("eval").getACall() or
  call = API::builtin("exec").getACall() or
  call = API::moduleImport("os").getMember("system").getACall() or
  call = API::moduleImport("subprocess").getMember(["call", "check_call", "check_output", "run", "Popen"]).getACall() or
  call = API::moduleImport("pickle").getMember(["load", "loads"]).getACall()
select call, "Potentially dangerous code execution function call."
findings.hypothesis: Search for dangerous code execution functions like eval, exec, os.system, subprocess calls
